trophies.guide: Unlock every other trophy in the game and this one pops automatically. There is no online requirement and no DLC trophy, so a single-player run is all it takes. Expect the road to run about 200 hours, most of it on the 100% checklist for A Long Road.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. Just play the story and it pops.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when Chapter 1 ends, as you start the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when Chapter 2 ends, as you begin the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when Chapter 3 ends, after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when Chapter 4 ends, after the final mission of the chapter, Starting From Zero.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you finish the final mission of the game. Some lists describe it as completing Chapter 5; either way, finishing the story is what pops it.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks during Chapter 2 when you complete the main mission Breakfast Run.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks during Chapter 3 when you complete the main mission The Cartel Heist.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks during Chapter 4 when you complete the main mission Child's Play.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks during Chapter 4 when you complete the main mission Headliners.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks during Chapter 4 when you complete the main mission VCIA Takedown.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks during Chapter 5 when you complete the main mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Finish the 100% Completion checklist, found under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story. It is far more forgiving than the name suggests, roughly 60% true completion: scan 200 of 277 vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals, finish 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditations and 15 of 18 card sets, plus any 100 optional missions. Only robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests are required in full. Progress you make during the story already counts, and nothing on the list is missable.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida. They split into 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps; flying under bridges is the fastest way to rack them up. The 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going after this pops. Track them under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. Each stunt has a unique name and stays marked once done.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race (car, race challenge or drone race), and performing a stunt. Check your progress under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. You will tick most of these off naturally while chasing the other trophies, so do not go out of your way for it.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every one of the 42 shooting-range challenges, spread across 12 ranges. PowerPyx has a dedicated page listing all 12 locations and the gold requirements for each challenge. Use it to plan your route, since golds are the only medal that counts.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 drone races in total). PowerPyx has a dedicated page with every location. Work through them one venue at a time and the trophy pops after the last one.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. PowerPyx lists 40 unique race locations around Leonida, so you have twice as many to choose from. Pick the ones you are comfortable with and do not repeat a race you already won.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you a fishing spot marked with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline and the challenge, and the trophy, comes from it.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game. There are four Video Games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck sits in arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game once. Beating every challenge is not required, so pick the one you enjoy most.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline. It is Lucia-only and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3, when Andy calls Lucia and texts her home address in Belville. Complete all five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass. The whole line stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline. It is marked automatically in Chapter 1; after the mission Island Dreams he calls you and appears as the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks. Follow his purple chest markers, use the metal detector to dig the treasure from the ocean floor, and bring it back. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3 (calling Brian as Jason speeds it up), so nothing here is missable.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete all five jobs: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands. Only certain questlines count. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward it. Confirmed counting strands are Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunt), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries); PowerPyx notes more are still being found. All of them remain available in free-roam after the story, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows your count.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline. It unlocks after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and get the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Track them under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List, and scan cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is on the list. Deliver them in good condition for more money. The cars turn up most often around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. It all stays doable after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline. It is Jason-only and gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers show Synthetic Labs around Vice City. Destroy them in the Take Out Kitty Litter quest, and once enough are gone Tyrone hands you the second quest, Spin On This, which pops the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida (10 locations, both Jason and Lucia, so each spot counts twice). Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THE MISSABLE ONE: the first meditation, at Jason's house in Chapter 1, can only be done then. After the Down to Earth mission, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. PowerPyx is unsure whether that first meditation is required for the trophy, so do it to be safe. The last meditation needs both characters together (after Chapter 2 Coffee Break). The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. His questline is Jason-only and starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts you about Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Do his first quest and he marks hunting spots with purple icons; bring the animals he requests back to him. The first quest gives you the unique rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker. There are 15 Target Decks in total and all of them are needed for 100%, so this comes naturally. PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed exactly which animal pops it.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 sets and 480 cards in the game; the 100% checklist needs 15 sets. PowerPyx has a dedicated page with every card-set location. Use it rather than hunting blind, since only 3 sets are needed for the trophy.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations by holding Up + R1 near them. Any 100 count, and there are far more than that. PowerPyx breaks them down as 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus tags. Just scan whatever you pass while playing and it adds up fast.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way there. Track them under Progress > Challenges (a Completed tick shows bottom-right when you scroll over one). Most complete naturally while you work on other trophies. Save this for near the end, then pick the easiest ones you have left.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape the heat. You need Chapter 2 Coffee Break first (free-roam together; call your partner with Right + Triangle). Cause enough chaos to reach 4 stars, then escape on a fast sports bike. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is the easiest route, since cops struggle on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops when you leave the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. It also comes automatically during the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is, since bank vault robberies always trigger 4 stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner without losing your wanted level. You need Chapter 2 Coffee Break first. Hit 3 green-icon robbery targets while the police chase you the whole time, keeping the red/blue flashing wanted level (not the red heat level). Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing items, and call your partner (Right + Triangle). The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City work well (after Chapter 3 Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs). Rob items and crack the back-room safe. The pop is delayed by about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop; if it does not fire, hit a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. There are 557 at launch, cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes. Open the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it; standing on a busy road and scanning traffic is the fastest way. Scanning is enough, you do not need to drive them. The 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so this pops on the way. Track it under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming. Time slows and weak spots are highlighted, but the purple focus bar drains in seconds. Buff your focus first (eat, drink, wash up at home; Adrenaline extends it, hold L1, press Triangle), then line up 5 enemies at a gang operation and drop them fast with an assault rifle like the Duke 556. Wear body armor so you can step out of cover. It does not work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus); shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots raise it, and by Focus Level 4 this is much easier.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from VCIA. Steal one of the big passenger planes that is docked to a departure terminal. It must be connected to a boarding bridge, not one sitting on the airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, take the stairs by the boarding bridge into the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse onto the airstrip and take off. Fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) from the airport and the trophy pops (slightly delayed).
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. They sit at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in, and shoot some enemies until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. It unlocks the Snap Gun for silently picking alarmed doors, and jewelry robberies appear as green icons on the map. Slip in through the back door with the Snap Gun (do NOT kick the door, that trips the alarm), find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm in the back room. The trophy pops shortly after you leave. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (Wait at the Cafe). It teaches the method and counts as your first vault. Tail a security van to a bank, wait for the guard to carry the cash in and open the vault, then get in fast and grab it; bring your partner (hold Right to hand off a bag, since you cannot carry it all). After Yasmani's earlier quests he sells security-van tips for $10,000, marking vans with a purple icon. Every vault robbery gives a 4-star wanted level. Escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles to shake the heat. There are 8 large bank jobs; this needs 5, but 100% needs all 8, and each pays up to $205,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is. Robbing a bank vault counts as robbing the truck that brought the cash. The earlier way: find an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, block it, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop once you have done his quests. All 8 large bank jobs are needed for 100% anyway, so this comes for free.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the map is clear. PowerPyx has a dedicated page on the best plane and route for unfogging quickly.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total; this needs one per gang, but 100% needs all 39, so it pops on the way. They show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically by the story. Track them under Progress > Gangs. Scroll over a gang and the bottom-right shows how many of its operations you have robbed.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it while standing next to the bar. That is the whole trophy.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the window. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. Only the blue Banshee works. It is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. The pop is slightly delayed, firing once you are further down the street.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. Buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation first. You need them for the safe. You visit during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Grab the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the north-east table, and blow the safe in the north-east hallway office. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. If you miss one, the robbery icon respawns after a while and you can go back for the rest. It does not need all three in one visit.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with BOTH Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check it under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). You need Chapter 2 Coffee Break first (character switching). Work out at a fitness club. Buy a membership, and always bring your partner (Right + Triangle): while you train, the other character trains automatically, so you progress twice as fast. You can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Your count is shown by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On). A little demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever your reputation moves. Profiles run from Professional (stealthy, clean escapes) through Hardened and Violent to Psycho, and Irredeemable is a permanent status from excessive violence that you should avoid. This comes naturally while working on everything else; if it is the last one left, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED. PowerPyx still lists this trophy as currently unknown. The best current evidence is gameplay footage (FlipKing Gaming, 19 Nov 2026) showing Lucia in an orange prison jumpsuit being escorted into an office, meeting a woman named Stephanie; the on-screen text reads BAD LUCK, I GUESS and Lucia's line is Bad luck, I guess. That points to a story scene in Lucia's prison introduction, not the Payday Loans store PowerPyx first guessed. Treat it as a story trophy you will pick up by playing. Do not go hunting for it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, and come solo. The spawn is slightly random: sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside. If it is not there, drive away and come back. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Walk up to it and it drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, then go back to her car at the roadside and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED. PowerPyx still lists this trophy as currently unknown. The description is Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by, and the consensus across guides is a melee attack from a moving vehicle, most likely kicking someone while riding a motorcycle. PowerPyx's own guess is the same. Try it once you have a bike; do not treat it as confirmed until a written guide verifies it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew). It unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder them. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most). The $250,000 is cumulative across all robberies, not in one trip. It comes naturally while doing robberies for the 100% checklist; a single bank vault can hold up to $205,000, but vaults only open after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to burn money since they are the most expensive. PowerPyx counts 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores. Plenty of places to spend it.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (4 more are story-related and do not count). They cost $160,000 in total. They unlock after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone. Buy them through the app. Robberies are the quickest money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app lands on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses); it lets you register stolen cars and have them delivered to you. You need enough garages first (see Little Boxes, each garage adds parking spots). Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register in his garage. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register Standard Tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
